name: ai-job-search
description: Search permitted public job APIs and feeds, filter roles, explain resume matches, and maintain a user-controlled application tracker in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: A skill-based job search assistant using ChatGPT's available browsing and file tools. Filters location, remote eligibility, and seniority; explains evidence-based resume scores; maintains an exportable tracker. Requires browsing for live searches. No hosted database, background monitoring, or application submission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find jobs matching my experience, explain the matches, and help me track my applications.
